service.description: Command Center (61380) and the Dozzle log viewer (61381), in this layer's reserved DX-service range 61300-61399 so they never collide with a per-project dev server. Definition only, bound to no zone until `ujust nomad-firewall-on`. Read this before assuming it protects anything: firewalld governs the LAN, and tailscale0 sits in the `trusted` zone, which accepts everything — so a container published on 0.0.0.0 is reachable from every device on the tailnet regardless of what this file says. That is why the Quadlet units publish on 127.0.0.1 instead, making `ujust remote-nomad-setup` the one deliberate entrance. Ollama (61382) is not listed here and must never be: it has no authentication and no rate limiting. Real access control across a tailnet is Tailscale ACLs, not firewalld.
